title: Fees charged
statementMd:
What is the total amount of fees charged (the sum is negative)?

Expected columns: `total_fees`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_fees FROM transactions WHERE kind = 'fee';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
